verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents central configuration: a dedicated `coderabbit` repository holding a `.coderabbit.yaml` that maintains config for the entire organization (coderabbit-docs-14). An `@coderabbitai configuration` command shows the resolved config on any PR, which implies layered defaults (coderabbit-docs-20), and auto-review settings can be scoped by branch, label and keyword (coderabbit-docs-21). missing for 10: documented mechanism for managing per-repo exceptions/overrides centrally (precedence rules between org and repo configs), evidence of rollout at scale across hundreds of repos, independent or hands-on corroboration.
